[[Burning Ground]] is a type of [[environment effect]] terrain that, for X seconds, inflicts [[burning]] to any non-[[minion]] [[creature]] walking over it.

*** [[Rragar's Menagerie]] (level 1)
*** [[Shards of Orr]] (level 2 and 3)
*** [[Slavers' Exile]] (Duncan and Selvetarm's levels)
*** [[A Time for Heroes]]
